justification: A served-output change: the Development Capacity card, which combines LEP limits with DCP setbacks, is withheld from Site Facts and shown in Council Rules only for a pilot council in zone R2

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Site Facts stops dropping the constraint_arithmetic section, the section is added back to the expected list, or the Council Rules card loses its pilot council and zone guard
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Removing the section filter fails the first test and re-adding the section to the expected list fails the second; both restored before commit

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads the existing constraint_arithmetic stream section and the pilot helpers in lib/pilot-focus.ts; nothing is written and the backend is unchanged
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If the section is renamed in the backend the filter silently stops matching and the card returns; the source-scan test names the section string
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every Site Facts and Council Rules page view after deploy; the card code is kept so it can be re-enabled
pre_impl.frontend_type: No type changes; one array filter and one added condition
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A visitor outside the ten councils sees no capacity card in the Planning Controls tab and Site Facts shows no Development Capacity section

functions.name: IntelligenceBriefInner
functions.input: the streamed Site Facts sections for one address
functions.output: the rendered report without the Development Capacity section
functions.if_none: an empty stream renders the existing loading and error states

functions.name: LepControls
functions.input: the property constraints, former council and lot data
functions.output: the Planning Controls tab, with the capacity card only for a pilot council in zone R2
functions.if_none: a missing council or zone hides the capacity card

values.if_missing: the capacity card is not shown
the council is found from the LGA name, otherwise the card is not shown

break_it.scenario: A Hornsby address in zone R3 opens Planning Controls
break_it.what_happens: The capacity card is not shown for that address
break_it.how: The guard needs both a pilot council and the pilot zone

break_it.scenario: The backend renames the capacity section
break_it.what_happens: The filter stops matching and the card appears in Site Facts again
break_it.how: Known limit: the filter is keyed on the section name; the source-scan test pins the current name only
break_it.repro: rename the section in services/intelligence_brief.py and open Site Facts

break_it.scenario: A Penrith house address in zone R2 opens Planning Controls
break_it.what_happens: The capacity card still shows as before
break_it.how: The added guard passes for a pilot council in the pilot zone and changes nothing else
break_it.repro: open Penrith R2 Planning Controls on the preview

post_merge.manual_verify: Open a Penrith R2 address in Council Rules and read the Planning Controls tab: the capacity card shows; open a Kellyville address: it does not; open Site Facts for any address: no Development Capacity section
